bidirectional_consistency_criteria.meaning: Forward and reverse relations must be exact inverses over the frozen governed domains.
bidirectional_consistency_criteria.rule: for every u in U and c in C: c in F(u) iff u in R(c)

bidirectional_consistency_criteria.meaning: Every governed carrier participates in the concrete accounting relation.
bidirectional_consistency_criteria.rule: union over all u in U of F(u) == C
no duplicate source_unit_id, carrier identifier, or relation edge is present

bidirectional_consistency_criteria.meaning: All relation endpoints resolve to the frozen domains.
bidirectional_consistency_criteria.rule: no dangling source-unit or carrier reference exists

forward_completeness_criteria.meaning: Every governed source unit has exactly one forward record and no out-of-domain source unit has a forward record.
Every governed source unit is accounted to at least one governed schema carrier.
forward_completeness_criteria.rule: for every u in U: F(u) is nonempty

forward_completeness_criteria.meaning: No forward record contains an out-of-domain carrier.
forward_completeness_criteria.rule: for every u in U: F(u) is a subset of C

forward_completeness_criteria.meaning: Forward records cannot silently relabel source units.
forward_completeness_criteria.rule: forward source_container and source_unit_kind metadata equal the frozen governed source-unit-domain metadata

forward_completeness_criteria.meaning: The schema flag is necessary structural data but is not accepted as self-proving evidence.
forward_completeness_criteria.rule: declared forward_complete must equal true, but FC01-FC04 must independently pass

future_req06_evaluation_rule.future_satisfied_only_if: all evidence preconditions and FC01-FC05 and BC01-BC04 pass

future_req14_evaluation_rule.future_satisfied_only_if: all evidence preconditions and RC01-RC03 and BC01-BC04 pass

notation.C: future separately authorized immutable governed schema-carrier domain
notation.F(u): set of governed schema carriers recorded for source unit u in the future concrete forward-accounting witness
notation.R(c): set of governed source units recorded for schema carrier c in the future concrete reverse-accounting witness
notation.U: future separately authorized immutable governed source-unit domain

preconditions_for_any_future_evaluation: U is nonempty, finite, checksum-bound, and contains unique source_unit_id values
C is nonempty, finite, checksum-bound, and contains unique canonical carrier identifiers
all four evidence identities are frozen before evaluation

reverse_completeness_criteria.meaning: Every governed carrier has exactly one reverse record and no out-of-domain carrier has a reverse record.
No reverse record contains an out-of-domain source unit.
reverse_completeness_criteria.rule: for every c in C: R(c) is a subset of U

reverse_completeness_criteria.meaning: The schema flag is necessary structural data but is not accepted as self-proving evidence.
reverse_completeness_criteria.rule: declared reverse_complete must equal true, but RC01-RC02 and bidirectional criteria must independently pass
